title: Live command timing and decision-effort instrumentation
description: Objective: make the production daemon/control-room path emit the benchmark's distinct timing and human-effort source observations instead of asking the harness to accept caller-supplied timestamp pairs. Deliverable: daemon command/event and control-room live instrumentation that binds trigger, server receipt/commit, client receipt, render and human commit observations to one command/run identity; records demanded decision commands, free interactions, focus/away intervals, attention switches and recovery burden; then feeds the existing SurfaceTimingReceipt evaluator through a real consumer edge. MEASURED GAP at HEAD 2b15b8f: daemon StreamEvent exposes only committedAt; live-event-feed copies only wire fields; evaluateTiming exists but has zero production call sites and accepts caller-supplied pairs; wire events omit commandId/actor/session needed for effort attribution, and no focus/activity or decision-effort record exists. Consumer: task-b937811e8b72459ea169e5fff1238ce1. NOT in scope: benchmark statistics, thresholds, competitor screen-capture instrumentation, corpus/campaign, UI claim verdicts, or provider usage. Owned paths: focused daemon HTTP/stream telemetry fields, generated client/live control-room instrumentation, and tests; preserve existing truth boundaries. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: The live production path binds trigger, server-received/committed, client-received, surface-rendered and human-command-committed observations to exact project/session/command/event/run identities; no layer compares timestamps from different clocks without an explicit observer/clock binding.

System latency and response time remain separate, away/focus intervals are recorded separately, and absent/unparseable/skewed observations return the existing or new stable UNKNOWN code plus exact layer instead of zero/absolute-value interpolation.

Demanded decision commands, free interactions, attention switches, recovery actions/burden and scroll/focus evidence are emitted as frozen observations with explicit source/provenance; the live path can distinguish create/approve/accept from any additional demanded decision.

At least one actual live control-room surface calls evaluateTiming/describeTimingReceipt using observed production timestamps, and daemon/client/control-room tests prove the real edge rather than a fixture-only helper.
Refusal tests pin exact code/layer and zero-vs-absent precedence; generated timing/decision cases assert non-zero exact cardinality, including every timing split and decision kind.

Mutation drills bypass a production render timestamp and a decision-command attribution guard and turn named live integration tests red; fresh pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test && pnpm typecheck exits 0.
taskRails: Do not collapse server, stream/client receipt, render and human time; response time is not system latency.
Do not compare cross-machine timestamps without an explicit shared observer or clock-offset uncertainty; unresolved skew is UNKNOWN.
Instrumentation is observational and grants no authority or evidence strength.
No benchmark thresholds, gate scoring, competitor screen-capture or confirmatory corpus bytes belong here.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; the cap is per file.
